triggers.name: interact
triggers.label: partner's target + interact key (like the pedal); waits until the warrior sees the priest's new target (DuoBox option relayTarget on both)

triggers.name: pickup
triggers.label: same kind of object as the priest's (DuoBox option 'Ramassage relaye' on both)

triggers.name: follow
triggers.label: DuoBox Follow button (F1): follows the partner, or stops if already following

triggers.name: victoryrush
triggers.label: panel icon 1: Victory Rush, action bar key F4 (slot 78, Battle Stance page)

triggers.name: slam
triggers.label: panel icon 2: Slam, action bar key F (slot 63)

triggers.name: execute
triggers.label: panel icon 3: Execute, action bar key 5 (slot 77, Battle Stance page)

triggers.name: thunderclap
triggers.label: panel icon 4: Thunder Clap, action bar key C (slot 79, Battle Stance page)

triggers.name: overpower
triggers.label: panel icon 5: Overpower, action bar key E (slot 62)

triggers.name: heroicstrike
triggers.label: panel icon 6: Heroic Strike, action bar key 1 (slot 73, Battle Stance page)

triggers.name: cleave
triggers.label: panel icon 7: Cleave, action bar key Shift+C (slot 80, Battle Stance page)

triggers.name: hamstring
triggers.label: panel icon 8: Hamstring, action bar key 4 (slot 76, Battle Stance page)

triggers.name: intimidatingshout
triggers.label: panel icon 9: Intimidating Shout, action bar key W (Action Bar 2 button 8, slot 68)

triggers.name: interactkey
triggers.label: panel icon 10: Interagir, the warrior's interact key T (INTERACTTARGET)

triggers.name: challengingshout
triggers.label: panel icon 11: Challenging Shout, action bar key Shift+3 (the user's binding)

triggers.name: sweepingstrikes
triggers.label: panel icon 12: Sweeping Strikes, key Shift+2 (the user's binding; saved bindings of 2026-11-07 had Shift+2 on stance button 2)

triggers.name: whirlwind
triggers.label: panel icon 13: Whirlwind, action bar key 2: the D-Whirlwind macro on button 2 of the Battle Stance and Berserker Stance pages (1st press Berserker Stance, 2nd press Whirlwind)

triggers.name: intercept
triggers.label: panel icon 14: Intercept, key Shift+< (the user's binding; < is the key left of W on a French keyboard). Berserker Stance only

triggers.name: mortalstrike
triggers.label: panel icon 15: Mortal Strike, key Shift+1 (the user's binding; Action Bar 6 button 1 = MULTIACTIONBAR5BUTTON1 in the saved bindings of 2026-11-11)

moves.name: strafeleft
moves.label: strafe left: Q = STRAFELEFT on the warrior

moves.name: backward
moves.label: move back: S = MOVEBACKWARD on the warrior (WoW's default key)

moves.name: straferight
moves.label: strafe right: right arrow, to bind to STRAFERIGHT on the warrior (unbound now)

camera.label: hold and move the mouse: the warrior's camera (DuoBox on the priest, tab DuoRelay)
